By way of present petition, the petitioner herein has prayed for the following reliefs:
"(a) Your Lordships be pleased to issue a writ of mandamus or any other appropriate writ, order and/or direction and further be pleased to direct the respondent passport authority to forthwith issue passport with respect to Application Reference No..
(ARN) 23-0016098650 dated 24.08.2023 in favour of petitioner, at Annexure-C.
(b) Your Lordships be pleased to please to direct the respondent authority to forthwith issue passport to the petitioner with respect to Application Reference No..
(ARN) 23-0016098650 dated 24.08.2023 pending the admission, hearing and final disposal of this petition, at Annexure-C.

2. Heard Ms. Nishka H. Prajapati, learned advocate appearing for the petitioner and Mr. Kshitij Amin, learned advocate appearing for the respondent.
3.1.
Ms. Nishka H. Prajapati, learned advocate appearing for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner was holding a valid passport issued by the respondent authority upto 15.10.2020.
The petitioner thereafter applied for re-issuance of passport on 24.08.2023 by Application Reference (ARN) No. 23- 0016098650.
The petitioner was given appointment on 06.10.2023 and was told to remain present at the passport office.
The petitioner remained present, copy of online appointment receipt is duly produced at Annexure-C.

Ms. Prajapati, learned advocate submitted that when the petitioner remained present before the competent authority, petitioner was told that since the criminal case is pending against the petitioner, petitioner to get an order from the Court for getting the passport of the petitioner renewed.

3.2. Being aggrieved by the aforesaid, petitioner constrained to approach this Court invoking Article-226 of the Constitution of India, and prayed for the reliefs as stated herein- NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/21038/2023 ORDER DATED: 16/01/2024 undefined above.

4.1. Ms. Prajapati, learned advocate submitted that the petitioner herein has been wrongfully arraigned as an accused for the offence registered as C.R. No. I-241 of 2010 with Ghatlodia Police Station on 22.10.2010, for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 114 of the Indian Penal Code.

It was submitted that the said complaint culminated into charge- sheet and it has been registered as Criminal Case No. 7971 of 2011, which is pending before the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ahmedabad (Rural), Mirzapur, Ahmedabad.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ahmedabad (Rural), Mirzapur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The discharge application filed by the co-accused person is pending for hearing, and the trial has not begun.
The complainant has expired in the year 2014, and therefore, summons to the complainant has returned back with the endorsement that the complainant has expired.

4.2. In light of aforesaid, Ms. Prajapati, learned advocate placed reliance on the Notification issued by the Central Government, Ministry of External Affairs bearing No.VI/401 /1 /5 /2019 dated 10.10.2019 and placing reliance on the same, NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/21038/2023 ORDER DATED: 16/01/2024 undefined submitted that the petitioner's application seeking re-issuance of passport be considered for a validity of five years.

Reliance was also placed on the order passed in Special Criminal Application No. 418 of 2017 dated 19.01.2017 and submitted that the prayers as prayed for by the petitioner herein may kindly be considered and the present petition may kindly be allowed.
5. Mr. Kshitij Amin, learned advocate appearing for the respondent was not in a position to controvert the submissions made by Ms. Prajapati, learned advocate appearing for the petitioner.

sentences.text:
Considering the aforesaid submissions advanced by the learned advocates appearing for the respective parties, the NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/21038/2023 ORDER DATED: 16/01/2024 undefined application seeking re-issuance of passport being Application Reference (ARN) No.
23-0016098650 dated 24.08.2023 duly produced at Pg. 20, Annexure-C, the respondent authority is directed to consider the same, in accordance with the Notification dated 10.10.2019 for a period of five years, as referred herein-above.

The aforesaid exercise be undertaken within a period of four weeks from the receipt of this order, considering the fact that the petitioner herein as submitted that there are some health issues with respect to the petitioner's mother-in-law, who resides in the United States of America (U.S.A.)
With the aforesaid directions, the present Petition stands allowed.
Direct service is permitted.
